results.description:
Lust is always heightened when it's forbidden. That's what I told myself repeatedly when Quinn enlisted as a soldier, and I was her commanding officer. For two years, she hated me for being tougher on her.  

Her sultry, lust-filled eyes tell another story.

While I watched her date other men, I craved her.

While she trained, I thanked God for loose combat pants.

Now, the Black Hawke team, a private security group, has made me an offer freeing me from the US Army fraternizing rules.
​​​​​​​
It's a big career decision with no guarantee the sassy little soldier will submit. But I'm not a man who takes no for an answer. Especially now that the rules of engagement have changed.  

THE COMMANDER is book nine in the Black Hawke Security series, a steamy forbidden military romance with spice and suspense. For readers who love alphas, warriors and delicious happy ever afters. Can be read as a standalone.

For readers who've enjoyed military romances by Susan Stoker, Anna Hackett, Cora Seton, Sybil Bartel and Rebecca Yarros.
